title: Lab for Developing and Testing Recommender Algorithms
text: Load package prepare dataset (included package). MovieLense data contains user ratings movies 1 5 star scale. use users 100 ratings. Train user-based collaborative filtering recommender using small training set. Create top-N recommendations new users (users 301 302). Use 10-fold cross-validation scheme compare top-N lists several algorithms. Movies 4 stars considered good recommendation. plot true negative vs. true positive rate top-N lists different lengths.
code: set.seed(1234)  library("recommenderlab") data("MovieLense")  MovieLense100 <- MovieLense[rowCounts(MovieLense) > 100, ] MovieLense100 ## 358 x 1664 rating matrix of class 'realRatingMatrix' with 73610 ratings. train <- MovieLense100[1:300] rec <- Recommender(train, method = "UBCF") rec ## Recommender of type 'UBCF' for 'realRatingMatrix'  ## learned using 300 users. pre <- predict(rec, MovieLense100[301:302], n = 5) pre ## Recommendations as 'topNList' with n = 5 for 2 users. as(pre, "list") ## $`0` ## [1] "Amistad (1997)"                    "Kama Sutra: A Tale of Love (1996)" ## [3] "Farewell My Concubine (1993)"      "Roommates (1995)"                  ## [5] "Fresh (1994)"                      ##  ## $`1` ## [1] "Bitter Moon (1992)"         "Touch of Evil (1958)"       ## [3] "Braindead (1992)"           "Great Dictator, The (1940)" ## [5] "M (1931)" scheme <- evaluationScheme(MovieLense100, method = "cross-validation", k = 10, given = -5,     goodRating = 4) scheme ## Evaluation scheme using all-but-5 items ## Method: 'cross-validation' with 10 run(s). ## Good ratings: >=4.000000 ## Data set: 358 x 1664 rating matrix of class 'realRatingMatrix' with 73610 ratings. algorithms <- list(`random items` = list(name = "RANDOM", param = NULL), `popular items` = list(name = "POPULAR",     param = NULL), `user-based CF` = list(name = "UBCF", param = list(nn = 3)), `item-based CF` = list(name = "IBCF",     param = list(k = 100)))  results <- evaluate(scheme, algorithms, type = "topNList", n = c(1, 3, 5, 10), progress = FALSE)  plot(results, annotate = 2, legend = "topleft")

title: Changes in version 0.2-0 (05/31/2016)
text: CRAN release: 2016-06-01 Added recommender RERECOMMEND recommend highly rated items (e.g., movies watch ). Added hybrid recommender (HybridRecommender). realRatingMatrix supports now subset assignment [. RECOM_POPULAR now shows parameters registry. RECOM_RANDOM produced now random ratings estimated distribution available recommendations (normal distribution user’s means standard deviation). predict now checks newdata (number items) compatible model. getTopNLists bestN gained randomized argument increase prediction diversity. Added getRatings method topNList.

title: Changes in version 0.1-9 (05/18/2016)
text: CRAN release: 2016-05-19 FIX: rownames newdata now preserved prediction output. use testthat now. Normalization now can done rows columns time. SVD column-mean imputation now folds new users. Added Funk SVD (funkSVD recommender SVDF). Added function error measures: MAE, MSE, RMSE, frobenius (norm). Jester5k contains now jokes. MovieLense contains now movie meta information. topNLists now also contains ratings. Removed obsolete PCA-based recommender.
